details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) A specific workflow or pipeline phase (for example clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix or orchestrate). Reply with the workflow file name.
B) A specific script or prompt under `scripts/` or `prompts/`. Reply with the path.
C) Documentation only (README.md, agents.md or docs/).
D) Not decided yet. Close this issue and open a new one with a concrete description of the problem and the expected behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for this change?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Reply with the workflow run ID, PR or issue number, or an error excerpt. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or runtime: fewer model tokens, fewer GitHub API calls, or less wall-clock time. Reply with the target metric.
C) Add new behavior or a new feature. Reply with the expected behavior and acceptance criteria.
D) Clarity or maintainability only (docs, comments). Reply with the files.
